strings.app.name: LemonGalaxy Worker
strings.svc.lost: Lost connection to the LemonGalaxy service.
strings.svc.notRunning: The LemonGalaxy service is not running.
strings.setup.title: Install LemonGalaxy Worker
strings.setup.info: Installing copies the program to Program Files, installs the LemonGalaxy service (starts at boot, reachable even before anyone signs in), and adds Start menu and Apps & Features entries. Accounts and settings live in ProgramData and are kept on update or uninstall. Requires administrator authorization.
strings.setup.tray: Show the tray icon after anyone signs in
strings.setup.noWorker: lemon-galaxy-worker.exe was not found. Please download the full package again.
strings.setup.stopped.title: The service is not running
strings.setup.stopped.info: The service connects this computer and handles remote control; this window only manages it. Nobody can connect while it is stopped.
strings.setup.noService.title: The service is not installed
strings.setup.noPipe: The service is running but its control interface does not respond
strings.setup.noPipe.info: Most likely an older service without the local control interface. Update with a newly downloaded package, or run lemon-galaxy-worker update from a command prompt.
strings.overview.deviceId.info: How controllers identify this computer in their device list.
strings.overview.noAccount: No account is signed in. Sign in so this computer shows up in your device list.
strings.overview.relogin: An account was reset by an administrator and must sign in again.
strings.overview.notInstalled: This copy is not installed: install it for a Start menu entry and a tray icon at sign-in.
strings.overview.foreground: The service runs in the foreground as {0} (command line run); closing that window stops it.
strings.overview.allowRemote.info: When off, no account can connect and active sessions end immediately. The person at this computer can turn it off; turning it back on needs administrator authorization.
strings.overview.server.info: The full address with the certificate fingerprint is on the Accounts page.
strings.overview.noSessions: Nobody is connected to this computer
strings.denied.title: Administrator access required
strings.denied.accounts: Only members of the Administrators group or the bound system user can view accounts.
strings.denied.settings: Only members of the Administrators group or the bound system user can view the service settings.
strings.denied.events: Only members of the Administrators group or the bound system user can view the event log.
strings.accounts.info: You can sign in several accounts (on the same server); this computer shows up in each account's device list. Each account has its own permissions here, enforced by this computer; controllers cannot change them.
strings.accounts.needsRelogin: Reset by an administrator; sign in again
strings.accounts.signOut.title: Sign out {0}?
strings.accounts.signOut.body: Its sessions end immediately and this computer is removed from its device list. Sign in again to allow it to connect.
strings.accounts.server.info: All accounts on this computer use the same server. Its certificate fingerprint is pinned, so a replaced certificate is rejected.
strings.policy.title: Permissions
strings.policy.systemUser.info: Remote terminals, commands and file access for this account run as this Windows account, with only its permissions. SYSTEM is risky and asks for confirmation.
strings.policy.notify.info: Show a notification when this account connects. The tray icon always changes color.
strings.policy.aiCap.info: The highest level AI may use on this computer for this account. Even if the controller picks a higher level, this limit applies. Off means AI cannot operate this computer.
strings.root.title: Run as SYSTEM?
strings.login.title: Sign In
strings.login.server.info: Copy the full address from the Server Info page of the admin console (host:port#sha256-fingerprint). The fingerprint is pinned, so a replaced server certificate is rejected.
strings.login.totp.hint: {0} uses two-factor authentication. Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
strings.login.newPassword.info: At least 8 characters. The password only takes part in OPAQUE on this computer, so neither the server nor administrators can learn it. If you forget it, an administrator must reset it and you sign in again on every device.
strings.login.newPassword.hint: This is the first sign-in for {0}. Set your own password.
strings.login.sysuser.hint: Signed in as {0}. Last step: choose which Windows account this account runs as on this computer.
strings.login.sysuser.fixed: Signed in as {0}. The service runs as a regular user, so this account also runs as {1}.
strings.login.tooShort: The new password must be at least 8 characters.
strings.login.switch.title: Switch servers?
strings.login.switch.body: {0} account(s) on server {1} are signed in on this computer. Switching servers signs them out.
strings.assist.info: Turn this on when someone needs to help you. Tell them the device code and verification code; they enter both in their LemonGalaxy app, and they can only connect after you click Allow. No account is needed. Ending assistance or quitting this app stops it.
strings.assist.server.info: Without a signed-in account, assistance is paired through this server. Copy the address from the Server Info page of the admin console (host:port#sha256-fingerprint).
strings.assist.waiting.info: You will be asked to confirm each request; unanswered requests are declined after 2 minutes.
strings.assist.other: Assistance was started in another window; the codes are shown there.
strings.assist.denied: Only the person at this computer or an administrator can start assistance.
strings.assist.fixedCode.info: By default a new random code is generated each time. A fixed code stays the same, which suits people who help you often. 8 to 16 letters or digits.
strings.assist.request.title: Assistance Request
strings.assist.request.heading: Someone wants to control this computer
strings.assist.request.info: If you allow it, they can see the screen, use the keyboard and mouse, and use the terminal and files with the permissions of the person at this computer. You can disconnect any time from Overview or the tray.
strings.settings.boot.info: The service is a Windows service (LemonGalaxyWorker): it starts at boot and can be reached before anyone signs in, whether or not this app is open. When off, the service starts manually.
strings.settings.tray.info: Put the LemonGalaxy icon in the tray after you sign in to Windows. It changes color while someone controls this computer and lets you disconnect them. Only affects you, and is separate from starting the service at boot.
strings.settings.lockOnEnd: Lock the screen after remote sessions
strings.settings.lockOnEnd.info: After someone viewed the desktop remotely, lock the screen 10 seconds after all such sessions end. Automatic reconnects do not trigger it, and terminal-only or file-only sessions do not count.
strings.settings.headless: Add a virtual display when there is no monitor
strings.settings.headless.info: When no monitor is connected (or it is off, or after a Remote Desktop session ends), a virtual display at this resolution is added when someone opens the screen list, and removed after the last session ends. Requires the LemonGalaxy virtual display driver.
strings.settings.autoUpdate.info: The service checks for a new version every 6 hours using a signed-in account, installs it only if the release signature and SHA-256 verify, then restarts itself. This app is not updated with it; update it with a new package.
strings.settings.version.info: Checks and updates the service (lemon-galaxy-worker.exe); the service downloads, verifies the signature and restarts itself.
strings.settings.updated: Updated to {0}; restart the service to use it
strings.settings.updatedRestarting: Updated to {0}; the service is restarting
strings.settings.personal.info: Only affects your own app on this computer, not the service or other users.
strings.settings.notifications.info: Show a system notification when someone connects or asks for assistance. Accounts with Notify when controlled turned off do not trigger it.
strings.events.info: Every connection, file operation and command is recorded on this computer. AI actions are marked, and rejected connections and blocked AI actions are shown as warnings. The log never leaves this computer.
strings.about.tagline: Self-hosted remote control, worker for this computer
strings.about.uninstall.row: Remove the worker from this computer
strings.about.uninstall.info: Stops and removes the service, the program files, the Start menu entry and the tray start-up entry. Accounts and settings are kept for a later reinstall. You can also uninstall from Settings → Apps.
strings.about.uninstall.title: Uninstall LemonGalaxy Worker?
strings.about.uninstall.body: The service is stopped and removed, so nobody can connect to this computer. Accounts and settings are kept in {0} for a later reinstall.
strings.tray.stillRunning.title: LemonGalaxy is still in the tray
strings.tray.stillRunning.body: Closing the window does not affect remote control. To exit the app, right-click the tray icon and choose Exit App.
strings.notify.connected.title: Someone connected to this computer
